summary: 本轮增量检索新增 1 项高相关工作，均于 2026-09-01 首次公开。`Does Imitation Learning Preserve Temporal Robustness in Dexterous Manipulation?` 直接研究模仿学习在灵巧操作中的时间鲁棒性，并提出 ParcelStow 基准来评测时序稳定性，因此纳入本次更新。相较上一轮，没有发现第二项同样独立且足够高相关的新工作。
summary_en: This incremental pass adds 1 newly public, highly relevant item from 2026-09-01. `Does Imitation Learning Preserve Temporal Robustness in Dexterous Manipulation?` studies temporal robustness in dexterous manipulation under imitation learning and introduces the ParcelStow benchmark, so it is included in this update. Compared with the previous run, no second item met the novelty and relevance bar.

items.title: Does Imitation Learning Preserve Temporal Robustness in Dexterous Manipulation?
items.authors_or_org: Yutong Wang, Yuchen Cheng, Yao Qiao, Zhenjia Xu
items.relevance: 这项工作直接研究灵巧操作中的模仿学习与时间鲁棒性，并提出专门基准 ParcelStow，核心关注点是灵巧手在时序扰动下的稳定执行，而不是通用机械臂操控。
items.relevance_en: This work directly studies imitation learning and temporal robustness in dexterous manipulation, and introduces the dedicated ParcelStow benchmark. Its core concern is stable dexterous execution under temporal perturbation rather than generic arm manipulation.
items.novelty_signal: 提出 ParcelStow 基准与对应评测流程，把时间稳定性作为灵巧操作的新评测维度，并公开代码、数据和文档。
items.novelty_signal_en: Introduces the ParcelStow benchmark and evaluation pipeline, making temporal stability a new axis for dexterous-manipulation evaluation, with code, data, and documentation linked publicly.
items.analysis_zh: 这篇工作的主要工作是检验并量化模仿学习在灵巧操作中的时间鲁棒性是否能够被保留，同时提出 ParcelStow 作为新的基准来专门测量这一点。它解决的问题不是一般性的“能不能抓起来”，而是灵巧手在时序扰动、动作延迟或节拍变化下能否仍维持稳定、可复现的操作表现。方法上，公开信息显示作者围绕 ParcelStow 设计了基准与评测流程，并结合通用模仿学习策略比较 temporal robustness；仓库还提供了代码、数据与在线文档，说明工作不仅停留在论文层面。实验上，摘要明确指出该基准用于评测桌面场景中的包裹投放/收纳类灵巧操作，并把 temporal robustness 作为核心指标；但公开摘要并未披露完整的定量结果、具体机器人平台或全部对比对象。总体来看，这项工作把“时间稳定性”这一常被忽视的维度带回灵巧操作评测主线，适合作为后续研究和复现实验的公共入口。限制是当前可公开获取的信息仍不足以判断其在更复杂接触策略、不同手型或更长时程任务上的泛化边界。
items.analysis_en: The main contribution is a study of whether imitation learning preserves temporal robustness in dexterous manipulation, together with `ParcelStow` as a benchmark that makes timing stability a first-class evaluation target. The problem is not simple pick-and-place success, but whether a dexterous hand remains stable and repeatable under temporal perturbations such as delay, phase shifts, or altered action cadence. Public information suggests that the authors built the benchmark and evaluation pipeline around `ParcelStow` and compared temporal robustness across imitation-learning approaches; the linked repository also exposes code, data, and documentation, which indicates this is more than a paper-only result. The experiments are described in the abstract as focusing on parcel stowing in desktop settings and measuring temporal robustness explicitly, but the public abstract does not disclose the full numerical results, the exact robot platform, or all baselines. Overall, the work brings temporal stability back into the center of dexterous-manipulation evaluation and should be useful as a shared entry point for follow-up research and replication. A limitation is that the currently public material is still insufficient to judge how far the approach transfers to more complex contact strategies, different hand embodiments, or longer-horizon tasks.

items.title: Potential-Guided Particle Steering for Negation-Constrained Dexterous Grasping
items.authors_or_org: Geonho Kim, SooGon Kim, Jongmin Lee
items.relevance: 这项工作直接处理语言驱动灵巧抓取中的否定约束问题，核心仍是多指或手部接触主导的灵巧抓取，而不是通用抓取或一般物体操作。
items.relevance_en: This work directly tackles negation constraints in language-driven dexterous grasping, keeping the focus on multi-finger, contact-centric grasping rather than generic grasping or general manipulation.
items.novelty_signal: 提出一种无需否定样本训练的推理时框架，把“不要抓某处”的约束显式纳入灵巧抓取采样，并新增 NegGrasp 基准来评测约束遵循能力。
items.novelty_signal_en: Introduces an inference-time framework that needs no negation-specific training data and explicitly enforces avoid constraints during dexterous grasp sampling, plus a new NegGrasp benchmark for constraint adherence.
items.analysis_zh: 这篇工作的主要工作是为否定约束灵巧抓取提出推理时框架，解决的是语言指令既指定抓取目标、又要求避开禁抓区域时，现有模型容易误抓的难题。方法上，它结合 Sequential Monte Carlo 与 classifier-free guidance，把采样朝目标区域引导，同时剪枝会朝禁抓区域收敛的候选，并用冻结的 3D part-grounding 模型定位禁抓部位。实验上，作者构建了 NegGrasp 基准，包含正/负成对指令和约束感知指标；在该基准上，方法把最强基线的违约率从 57.9% 降到 17.2%，并同时提升约束感知成功率与物理成功率。总体上，这项工作说明否定约束是语言驱动灵巧抓取中的真实痛点，推理时约束建模可有效缓解问题。限制在于，公开信息显示其主要验证仍集中在基准与推理框架本身，尚不清楚对更复杂多步抓取或更丰富手部接触策略的泛化边界。
items.analysis_en: The main contribution is an inference-time framework for negation-constrained dexterous grasping, addressing the failure mode where language-driven grasp models can correctly identify the target but still grasp a forbidden part when the instruction includes an explicit avoid clause. The problem is practical and well-defined: existing datasets contain almost no avoidance instructions, so retraining on negation examples is not scalable. The method combines Sequential Monte Carlo with classifier-free guidance to steer samples toward the instructed target while pruning candidates that head toward the forbidden region, and it uses a frozen 3D part-grounding model to localize the excluded part from language. For evaluation, the authors introduce NegGrasp, a benchmark with paired positive/negative instructions and constraint-aware metrics. On NegGrasp, the paper reports that the violation rate drops from 57.9% for the strongest baseline to 17.2%, while both constraint-aware and physical success improve. The conclusion is that negation handling is a meaningful missing piece in dexterous grasping, and inference-time constraint enforcement can be effective without negation-specific training data. A limitation, based on the public information, is that the reported validation is centered on the benchmark and the proposed inference mechanism, so broader generalization to longer-horizon grasping or richer contact-rich manipulation remains insufficiently disclosed.

items.title: Facet-0: A Robotic Foundation Model for Contact-Rich Precise Manipulation
items.authors_or_org: Haoyuan Deng, Haichao Liu, Wenkai Guo, Yuan Ling, Zaijia Yang, Yuanjiang Xue, Haosheng Sun, Liangzi Wang, Ziwei Wang
items.relevance: 这项工作把接触丰富、亚毫米级精度的精密操作作为核心任务，围绕真实机器人装配中的接触结果建模与策略优化展开，属于灵巧操作的高相关近邻。
items.relevance_en: This work centers on contact-rich, sub-millimeter precision manipulation and optimizes contact outcomes in real robotic assembly, making it a strong neighboring contribution to dexterous manipulation.
items.novelty_signal: 提出 action-wrench 联合建模的机器人基础模型，并在 1,000 小时的力同步装配数据上进行训练，强调接触结果预测与真实系统适配。
items.novelty_signal_en: Introduces a robotic foundation model with joint action-wrench modeling, trained on 1,000 hours of force-synchronized assembly data and designed around contact-outcome prediction and real-system adaptation.
items.analysis_zh: 这篇工作的主要工作是提出 Facet-0，一个面向接触丰富精密操作的机器人基础模型，解决的是亚毫米装配中对空间精度、顺应性交互和接触失败鲁棒性的要求。方法上，它把视觉-语言语义、运动状态与因果 wrench 历史对齐，再用 flow matching 一次性生成动作块及其对应的未来 wrist-wrench 轨迹，同时通过 distributional Action-Wrench Critic、phase-aware reward 和 contact-selective credit 强化那些真正决定接触成败的交互。实验上，模型在 ManuFacet-1K 上训练，该数据集包含 1,000 小时、跨三种 embodiment 和多个制造单元的力同步数据；在五个亚毫米级电脑装配任务上，定制后的系统平均成功率达到 82%，优于最强基线的 15%，并报告了 0.5 mm 放置精度与 50 ms 指令延迟。总体来看，这表明接触结果显式建模对精密装配非常关键，且可在真实机器人上带来显著收益。限制是公开信息尚未充分披露不同装配零件类型、失败模式分布以及对更广泛手部灵巧任务的泛化范围。
items.analysis_en: The main contribution is Facet-0, a robotic foundation model for contact-rich precise manipulation that treats the consequences of contact as a first-class prediction target. It tackles a concrete problem in real-world assembly: sub-millimeter tasks require not only geometric precision but also compliance and robustness to contact failures. The method aligns causal wrench history with vision-language semantics and kinematic state, then uses flow matching to generate action chunks together with the future wrist-wrench profile they are expected to induce; training also includes a distributional Action-Wrench Critic, phase-aware rewards, and contact-selective credit assignment. The experiments use ManuFacet-1K, a 1,000-hour force-synchronized corpus spanning three embodiments and multiple manufacturing cells. Reported results show 82% mean success on five sub-millimeter computer-assembly tasks, compared with 15% for the strongest baseline, along with 0.5 mm placement accuracy and 50 ms command latency. The conclusion is that explicit action-contact coupling can substantially improve high-precision assembly on real hardware. A limitation, from the public information, is that the paper does not yet fully spell out the breadth of part diversity, failure breakdowns, or how far the approach transfers beyond the reported assembly settings.
